observations.behavior: Adds a new kea-based logic module P1.F20.H1 that fetches and displays AI watch-picks, with loaders, reducers, selectors and listeners; P1.F21.H1 adds a variant type and a flag parser.
observations.posthog_connection: Captures analytics events replay_vision_watch_picks_shown, replay_vision_watch_picks_list_mode_changed, replay_vision_watch_clip_clicked, and records mark-viewed status; this could help PostHog understand how users discover and consume AI-generated picks, and could support future A/B or feature-flag evaluation.
